modules.name: ThisWorkbook
modules.source:
Private Sub Workbook_BeforeClose(Cancel As Boolean)
    DocCount = DocCount + 1
    Journal = Journal & "D"
    Cancel = False
End Sub

modules.name: AppWatcher
modules.source:
Private WithEvents watched As Excel.Application
Public Sub Connect(ByVal app As Excel.Application)
    Set watched = app
End Sub
Private Sub watched_WorkbookBeforeClose(ByVal Wb As Excel.Workbook, Cancel As Boolean)
    AppCount = AppCount + 1
    Journal = Journal & "A"
    SameBook = Wb Is ThisWorkbook
    Cancel = True
End Sub

modules.name: Api
modules.source:
Public Journal As String
Public AppCount As Long
Public DocCount As Long
Public SameBook As Boolean
Public observer As AppWatcher
Public Function RunProbe() As String
    Dim stage As Long
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = 1
    Set observer = New AppWatcher
    stage = 2
    observer.Connect ThisWorkbook.Application
    stage = 3
    ThisWorkbook.Close SaveChanges:=False
    RunProbe = AppCount & ":" & DocCount & ":" & Journal & ":" & SameBook
    Set observer = Nothing
    Exit Function
Failed:
    RunProbe = "FAIL:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Journal & ":" & AppCount & ":" & DocCount
End Function
